<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>capture-project-work</code></p>

Route one project thought to the correct knowledge layer without duplicating it or overstating its commitment.

## When to use

Route one project thought to todo, OpenSpec, changelog, or skill improvement at its current commitment level without duplication or premature promotion.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link capture-project-work --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link capture-project-work --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Compatibility

Source kinds: `openspec`, `changelog`, `todo-txt`.

## Learning outcomes

- Route incoming work to todo, OpenSpec, changelog, or the skill improvement pipeline.
- Preserve shared and private scope while avoiding duplicate project knowledge.

## Examples

### Capture a hot project thought

**Prompt**

> Use the capture-project-work skill to record this unrefined implementation thought without changing accepted product specifications.

**Expected outcome**

The thought is captured in the appropriate todo source with its scope and wording preserved.

### Record an accepted decision

**Prompt**

> Use the capture-project-work skill to place this approved product decision in the correct project source without writing release history yet.

**Expected outcome**

The accepted intent is represented in OpenSpec and unrelated sources remain unchanged.
